card.name: Quantity words after a clause
card.fires_on: Quantity or time words such as many, some, few, every, days that follow a complete clause and lead into a noun like times, years, day or cents.

modes.label: Many/some before time nouns
modes.description: Many, some or every placed right after a clause, before years, times or day.
modes.example: since Hillary Rodham Clinton’s speech in China so<< many>> years ago

modes.label: Few before amounts
modes.description: A quantity word such as few or days introduces a small amount or a period.
modes.example: levels only a<< few>> cents above what consumers pay

modes.label: Variable name in code-like text
modes.description: A variable name such as area in a worked calculation line.
modes.example: Calculate the area of the room:<< area>> = length * width

card.plain: It fires on words like many, some and every that come before words like years, times or day.
